hero.headline: Where Every Journey Becomes
hero.subtext: Handcrafted travel experiences across India's most breathtaking landscapes — from the high passes of Ladakh to the backwaters of Kerala.

banner.text: 🎉 Early bird discount on Ladakh — Book before July 15!

testimonials.name: Rahul Sharma
testimonials.text: Ladakh was always on my bucket list and Dream Escape made it absolutely perfect. The SUV transfers, the guesthouses, the guide who knew every pass by name — everything was top class. Not a single hiccup in 9 days.

testimonials.name: Priya Nair
testimonials.text: I was nervous travelling as a solo woman but the team at Dream Escape made me feel completely safe throughout. The itinerary was packed but never rushed. Pangong Lake at sunrise — I will never forget it.

testimonials.name: Arjun Mehta
testimonials.text: Booked for our group of 8 friends. The coordination was flawless — permits, transfers, meals, everything sorted before we even arrived in Leh. Value for money is unbeatable. Already planning next year's trip with them!

testimonials.name: Sneha Kulkarni
testimonials.text: My husband and I celebrated our anniversary in Ladakh with Dream Escape. The team arranged a surprise cake at the campsite by Pangong — it was the most thoughtful thing. Highly recommend for couples!

packages.name: Ladakh — The Roof of the World
packages.desc: Experience the raw, breathtaking beauty of Ladakh — high-altitude deserts, turquoise lakes, ancient monasteries, and star-filled skies unlike anywhere on Earth.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Leh — Acclimatisation
itinerary.desc: Arrive in Leh (3500m). Rest and acclimatise. Evening walk around the local market. Welcome briefing over dinner.

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, and the vibrant Leh Market. Easy acclimatisation hike in the evening.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.desc: Cross Khardung La (5359m), one of the worlds highest motorable passes. Arrive Nubra Valley, camel safari on the Bactrian camels.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley — Diskit & Hunder
itinerary.desc: Visit Diskit Monastery and the giant Maitreya Buddha statue. Explore sand dunes at Hunder village.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Lake
itinerary.desc: Drive through Shyok Valley to the iconic Pangong Tso lake (4350m). Watch the lake change colours — blue, turquoise, green.

itinerary.title: Pangong Lake — Free Day
itinerary.desc: Sunrise at the lake shore. Optional hike along the lakeside. Photography session at the famous 3 Idiots viewpoint.

itinerary.title: Pangong to Leh via Chang La
itinerary.desc: Return to Leh crossing Chang La Pass (5360m). Visit Hemis Monastery en route.

itinerary.title: Magnetic Hill & Indus Valley
itinerary.desc: Visit Magnetic Hill, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, Sangam confluence of Indus and Zanskar. Evening in Leh free.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Transfer to Leh airport for your onward journey. Carry the memories of a lifetime.
